info.syllabusName: Môi trường trong xây dựng (Civil Engineering and Sustainable Built Environment)
info.syllabusEnglish: Civil Engineering and Sustainable Built Environment
info.description:
Nội dung khóa học:
Tổng quan về kỹ thuật đánh giá tác động môi trường trong công trình dân dụng.
Các phương pháp phân tích, đánh giá rủi ro môi trường trong xây dựng làm cơ sở đề xuất giải pháp bảo vệ, phòng ngừa các yếu tố môi trường.
Kiến thức về phát triển bền vững trong môi trường xây dựng.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails:
Knowledge: 
Provide the overview of  civil and environmental engineering activities.
The importance of sustainable build development.
Role of engineers in society
The reporting method of environmental impact assessment is instructed during this course.

Operational skills: 
Students can build up an overall picture of civil and environmental engineering activities.
Understand the importance of sustainable development and develop a sustainable built environment.

Thinking Requirement: 
Students must have abilities to identify all related environmental impacts and risk in civil constructive engineering.
Analyses and suggest solutions to prevent or eliminate risks and impacts.

Attitude and behavior:
Students are trained professional attitude and passion for future career.
